sections.text_helper: Section 28.4.14 "XSPI system configuration" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1314.
sections.section_content:
The XSPI is configured using XSPI_CR. The user must program:
• the functional mode with FMODE[1:0]
• the automatic status-polling mode behavior if needed with PMM and APMS
• the FIFO level with FTHRES
• DMA use with DMAEN
• the timeout counter use with TCEN
• the dual-memory configuration, if needed, with DMM
In case of an interrupt use, the respective enable bit can also be set during this phase.
If the timeout counter is used, the timeout value is programmed in XSPI_LPTR.
The DMA channel must not be enabled during the XSPI configuration: it must be enabled
only when the operation is fully configured, to avoid any unexpected request generation.
The DMA and XSPI must be configured in a coherent manner regarding data length:
FTHRES value must reflect the DMA burst size.
